call the Coordinated Entry Phone Line 615-862-6444 (Mon-Fri 8:00am-4:30pm): eligibility requires meeting the HUD definition of homelessness (literally homeless / category 1); staff connect callers to the housing allocation and assessment process
Family Coordinated Entry Line is also 615-862-6444; Individual Coordinated Entry: 629-252-8656 or 629-252-8646 (Metro Housing Division)

specialized access points: youth - Oasis Center; veterans - VA and Operation Stand Down Tennessee; fleeing domestic violence - call the DV Coordinated Entry line 615-955-0620 (Jean Crowe Advocacy Center) for a confidential Coordinated Entry assessment at the Family Safety Center

FRONT-DOOR FINDING (verified 2026-10-22): the CoC's collaborative applicant role was transferred from MDHA (Metropolitan Development and Housing Agency) to the Metro Office of Homeless Services (OHS); OHS now runs Coordinated Entry and the annual Point-in-Time count. MDHA remains the housing authority (public housing / vouchers / development) but is NOT the CoC front door
orgs.serves: people experiencing homelessness in Nashville-Davidson County seeking connection to housing programs
